reason: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that adds selection controls and confirmation-based permanent deletion for sessions, with automatic sidebar patch repair after upgrades.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加会话勾选和确认删除功能，并在升级后自动修复相关界面补丁。
summaries.en: Adds session selection and confirmation-based deletion controls to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar while automatically repairing its interface patch after upgrades.

capabilities: Adds sidebar controls and row checkboxes for selecting sessions
Permanently deletes selected session data and related metadata after confirmation
Modifies and reapplies a sidebar patch automatically after application upgrades
Uses a local loopback API for session deletion operations
